original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.

actual_scope: Can the production p112-free-sink-audit97 independent.py adopt the proved modulo-521 signed-determinant kernel from research/p112-signed-modular86/ so the shipped free-sink audit is faster while every case/minor receipt stays identical, without reopening leave-alone tooling through #2412 or pending omission-lanes / deferred dyadic production packages?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after surveying remaining proved opt-in adapters. Leave-alone objects through #2412, pending cursor/omission-lanes-production-60b9, and deferred ck-dyadic-replay-production / scalar-fused-dyadic-production were skipped. woklerx's merged #1144 opt-in already proved ~3.87× (host remeasure ~4.4×) with identical receipts; production independent.py still used Fraction elimination. This session wires that equivalent rewrite into the shipped checker, vendors pairwise baseline bytes, and retargets the opt-in reference to the vendored baseline.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: the P112 free-sink independent audit is reused by historical sink tooling. A faster identical receipt does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production independent.py modular-determinant change with frozen baseline, identical audit outcomes, corruption controls, pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median clearly above ~1.5× with stable per-round ratios. Do not invent kappa, reopen leave-alone objects, or open an upstream CrocSwap PR from this worker.
evidence: PASS_P112_SIGNED_MODULAR_PRODUCTION via research/p112-signed-modular-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; PASS_IDENTICAL_P112_SIGNED_MODULAR_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via pinned-CPU benchmark.py --rounds 5 (median 0.681→0.143 s, 4.754×; per-round 4.618–4.880×); opt-in p112-signed-modular86 retargeted to vendored baseline.py.
author: Wentao Li
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for orientation, overlap search, profiling, production wiring, packaging, benchmarking and writing. Not independent human peer review.
